newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Morgan Australia survey shows fewer jobs.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Australia survey shows fewer jobs.

text.p: Recruitment company Morgan and Banks Ltd said on Wednesday its 1997 second quarter (May-July) job index survey showed that a net 16.3 percent of employers planned to hire staff compared with 20.7 percent in the first quarter.
The company said every state showed a fall in hiring intentions, with South Australia recording the largest decline followed by Victoria and New South Wales.
It said the survey showed weakness in the jobs market in the tourism sector as well as the electronics industry, with the strongest being information technology and telecommunications.
The survey was based on responses from 3,200 firms.
